Entries.Original: In Gig Mode, you play a rhythm mini-game featuring the game's songs.
Start off by selecting a difficulty level.
Clearing each of these missions will reward you with stars.
You can edit the squad formation you wish to perform this gig from here.
Your gig score will increase the higher your squad's rating is.
You can view your squad's gig skills from here.
Press down on the right stick to view your gig skills.
Characters will activate different skills during a performance depending on their role.\nThe higher the rarity of a Memoria, the greater effect its skills will have.
Press the X button to return.
Press this button to begin your performance.
Press the O button to begin your performance.
You can move to GIG FEST from here.
You can move to GIG FEST by pressing the △ button.
You can now unlock a song's Easy to Hard difficulties\nwithout using stars by simply clearing its associated story.\nThe Expert difficulty is unlocked by clearing the song on Hard.
